proposed_runtime.source_batch_timer_note: Current source timer starts after full snapshot verification; total lifecycle must remain bounded by outer candidate deadline

stop_conditions.host_swap_out: Positive delta of /proc/vmstat pswpout across two consecutive sample intervals
stop_conditions.immediate_conditions: Lost monitoring/SSH, invalid metrics, disk floor breach, container OOM/exit, source integrity failure, pg32 or pg32b stops or becomes unhealthy, or user cancellation
stop_conditions.action: Cancel only the exact named one-shot candidate container; bounded TERM then KILL and verify absence. Preserve incomplete evidence and stop later batches; never restart unrelated services or retry automatically.

required_before_real_execution: Approve exact small scope and changed outer execution deadlines separately
Implement bounded real host/controller path; verify with artificial inputs and unchanged resource pressure limits
Select actual immutable candidate ID, roots and all descriptor digests outside the request
Obtain explicit real snapshot-only read authorization and operational no-writer window
Choose private new output/scratch; preserve failed artifacts and reject reuse
Recheck live host state and full snapshot under monitoring; no NAS access
No PostgreSQL operation, freeze, import, alias promotion or service replacement

non_execution_notice: Review artifact with no executable request or APPROVED_READONLY_BATCH file; cannot be passed directly to current entry/controller.
